Name: Fox squirrel custom pet - Teto from Nausicaa (Ghibli)
Author: Sharogg
Description:
This cute little guy is waiting to be adopted by you!


[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/59674311-1773528136.png[/img]

[list]
[*]Custom pet that doesn't replace any existing pets
[*]Adoptable from start with adapted Marnie adoption event
[*]Tweaked behaviours/animations based on the cat
[*]Custom sounds
[*]Super cute
[/list]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/59674311-1773528397.png[/img]

Unzip the mod and paste it into Stardew Valley's Mods folder. Make sure you have all the dependencies installed. 1.6. is required.
